spans.s: Lavaṇa^1, an Asura (according to Nīl.). § 39 (Rāmaṇīyaka): I, 27, 1305 (had been seen on the island Rāmaṇīyaka).
Lavaṇa^2, a Rākshasa. § 730g (Upamanyu): XIII, 14, 861 (ºsya rakshasaḥ, had been slain by Māndhātṛ with the śūla of Śiva).
Lavaṇāśva, a ṛshi. § 324 (Dvaitavanapr.): III, 26, 986 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).
